qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Delen Private Bank (~50% of holding earnings) charges recurring % AUM fees that compound with financial wealth with near-zero client churn. DEME holds an entrenched global oligopoly in specialized marine dredging and offshore wind turbine installation.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Cash Conversion & Fortress Balance Sheet, REJECT). While Delen Private Bank is an elite wealth compounder, AvH fails Gate 6 due to structural portfolio exposure to capital-intensive cyclical marine contracting (DEME), commercial fractional-reserve banking (Bank Van Breda), and real estate, resulting in heavy fleet capex and consolidated LT debt/OE exceeding 4.0x.
qualitative.evidence: Consolidated LT debt of €2.80B against €592.5M TTM net income results in LT debt / NI of 4.7x. DEME requires heavy recurring vessel capex (€469M capex in FY25, €514M in FY22), and Bank Van Breda operates as a fractional-reserve commercial lender. Although the parent company is net cash and Delen generates exceptional cash conversion, the consolidated look-through capital structure fails Munger's fortress balance sheet standard.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
